Every record reaches every rank: record identified coarse rank kept explicit unidentified category rank, ring accounts material examined parent equals sum children. Diet summarized shares prey records (numbers) weight every rank, alongside classical frequency occurrence. declared covariate (period, year, size class, length bins, region, ...) can stratify views, dv_digestion_diagnostic() describes identification depth changes digestion state.

Three architectures expressed two arguments: Pooled (default): scope = "pooled", min_predators = 1. Counts taken across whole dataset. Pooled cross-predator: scope = "pooled", min_predators = 2. category retained subtree also spans least min_predators predator species. Per-predator: scope = "per_predator". Counts taken within predator separately, predator gets tree. taxonomy columns returned object pruned: every record, ranks finer settled rank set NA, explicit-NA machinery dv_build_tree() shows merge, sunburst leaf rarer threshold stomachs (apart records unidentified every rank begin , other_label group). convenience column prey_category (settled label) prey_rank (rank settled ) added, result can also feed flat set x category matrix.
